description: Browse WebDAV storage and transfer files from C#/.NET applications without hand-writing DAV requests or parsing XML. Upload, download, copy, move and delete remote files with strongly typed async APIs, streaming and cancellation support. Targets .NET 8 and .NET 10. Nextcloud and ownCloud compatibility is not verified; validate your server and configuration.
releaseNotes:
Version 3.1.0
* Transfers: Add DownloadFileAsync with strong validators, verified durable checkpoints, bounded streaming and atomic no-overwrite completion.
* Downloads: Add opt-in identity representation enforcement through DownloadOptions.RequireIdentityEncoding.
* Documentation: Add a resumable-download guide, complete application and runnable example in the current documentation layout.
* No automatic retries, resumable uploads or durable directory synchronization.
Version 3.0.4
* Examples: Add Nextcloud and ownCloud Server listing/download commands with vendor-specific property selection and app-password setup guides.
* Documentation: Link server integration guides from the embedded README; no new verified-server compatibility claims.
* No library API or runtime behavior changes.
Version 3.0.3
* Documentation: Lead with an authenticated list-and-download application and move detailed contracts and legacy recipes into focused guides.
* Examples: Add runnable authentication, listing/properties, transfer, file-management, locking and collection-sync examples with matching guides and regression coverage.
* Compatibility: Separate server verification evidence from implemented protocol and extension support; no unverified compatibility or conformance claims.
* No library API or runtime behavior changes.
Version 3.0.2:
* Discovery: Describe WebDAV storage and file-transfer use cases and expand NuGet search tags, without claiming verified Nextcloud or ownCloud compatibility.
* Documentation: Explain server-specific compatibility limits in the README overview.
* No public API or runtime behavior changes.
Version 3.0.1:
* Documentation: Correct the embedded README to identify 3.0.0 as released on October 20, 2026 and install v3 from NuGet without a local build.
* Licensing: Declare MIT as the single package license with owner authorization; retain historical upstream attribution and the previous license record.
* No public API or runtime behavior changes.
Version 3.0.0 (released 2026-10-20):
* New resource-oriented DavClient with immutable endpoints, request-scoped options and no implicit discovery.
* Lossless XML property values, exact resource/property outcomes, typed property codecs and structured DAV errors.
* Conditional requests, full structured DAV If expressions, ordered atomic PROPPATCH and safe namespace replacement defaults.
* HEAD, response-owning downloads, verified byte ranges, explicit upload ownership, shared/exclusive locks and streamed listings with completion tracking.
* Public REPORT execution seam and an explicit sync-level 1 collection synchronization batch profile; no durable sync or automatic retries.
* Shared XML readers with legacy compatibility projections; existing Client/IClient signatures and transport ownership retained.
* Migration guidance and contract tests for both .NET 8 and .NET 10. This release does not claim full RFC conformance.
* Release hardening: Reject property-only namespace mutation outcomes and nested LOCK scalar markup; preserve streamed-listing rejection errors with bounded reads.
* Examples: Add a modern sample, require explicit legacy partial-PUT opt-in, and compile complete README examples on both targets.
Legacy improvements already released in 2.8.0:
* Developer experience: Ship XML documentation for both targets, safe configurable examples, early argument validation, qualified property statuses, explicit authentication factories, sanitized exception context, and complete configuration/ownership guidance.
* Configuration: Reject ineffective client TLS callbacks on injected transports and validate owned upload timeouts before transport allocation.
* Sample correctness: Report transfer-integrity failures with a nonzero exit while retaining run-owned cleanup.
* PROPPATCH correctness: Read statuses and descriptions only from direct propstat children, never nested property values.
* Performance: Filter listings in place, skip unused property-name XML, retain only selected single-item results, avoid PUT response buffering, and coordinate concurrent root discovery.
* Reliability: Cancellable asynchronous metadata parsing with configurable body deadlines; cancellation-aware discovery; consistent 409 exceptions; complete response ownership; member-level mutation recovery diagnostics.
* Bug fixes: Correct partial transfer ranges, connection reconfiguration, URL joining, sparse listings, targeted XML values, PROPFIND failure statuses, OPTIONS discovery, empty-namespace properties and hidden values.
* Security: Reject absolute WebDAV URLs outside the configured origin (scheme, hostname and effective port), preventing metadata-driven HTTPS downgrades and credential disclosure.
* Security: Scope PROPFIND resource identities and typed properties to their DAV namespace and structural position.
Historical context (already released in 2.7.0):
* Feature: WebDAV LOCK / UNLOCK support (RFC 4918 §9.10–9.11).
* Feature: WebDAV PROPPATCH support — set / remove custom properties (RFC 4918 §9.2).
* Bug fix: COPY / MOVE now send the Overwrite header (RFC 4918 §9.8.3 / §9.9.3); 204 No Content accepted as success.
* Bug fix: DELETE now sends Depth: infinity (RFC 4918 §9.6.1).
* Feature: per-call lock-token submission via the If header on PUT / DELETE / MOVE / COPY (RFC 4918 §10.4).
* Internal refactor: extracted Client.cs static helpers into focused, unit-testable helper classes under WebDAVClient.Helpers.
* Feature: PROPFIND request-body variants — <prop> and <propname/> in addition to <allprop/> (RFC 4918 §9.1).
* Feature: HTTP OPTIONS support — discover DAV compliance classes and allowed methods (RFC 4918 §9.1, RFC 9110 §9.3.7).
* Feature: Bearer token / OAuth 2.0 authentication via new Client constructor overloads (static token or async refreshable provider).
